# --input-static-assets-directory embeds a directory of the templates
# package and --output-static-assets-path serves it with GET under a path;
# TemplateRoutePaths gains a method returning that path.

muxt generate --input-static-assets-directory=assets --output-static-assets-path=/static --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check
grep '^//go:embed assets$' template_routes.go
grep ' --output-static-assets-path=/static' template_routes.go
exec go test -count=1

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}
-- assets/app.css --
p{color:red}
-- assets/.hidden.css --
p{color:blue}
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<link rel="stylesheet" href="{{.Path.ReadStatic}}app.css">{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

func (Server) Index() string { return "" }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestStaticAssets(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	paths := TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	if got, want := paths.ReadStatic(), "/static/"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("ReadStatic() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}

	for _, tt := range []struct {
		path   string
		status int
		body   string
	}{
		{path: "/static/app.css", status: http.StatusOK, body: "p{color:red}\n"},
		{path: "/static/.hidden.css", status: http.StatusNotFound},
		{path: "/static/missing.css", status: http.StatusNotFound},
	} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tt.path, nil))
		if rec.Code != tt.status {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", tt.path, rec.Code, tt.status)
		}
		if tt.body != "" && rec.Body.String() != tt.body {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want %q", tt.path, rec.Body.String(), tt.body)
		}
	}

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(rec.Result().Body)
	if !strings.Contains(string(body), `href="/static/app.css"`) {
		t.Errorf("GET / body = %q, want it to link /static/app.css", body)
	}
}
